rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.2, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.9, rationale=iter-4: continue init_t descent 0.4->0.2 (near-pure FBP passthrough; minimal prior perturbation). PRIOR trend: RMSE monotonically falls as init_t drops (iter-1 init_t0.7 RMSE 0.01428 -> iter-3 init_t0.4 RMSE 0.01357, SSIM 0.741->0.895, PSNR 27.58->28.02) but is still 2.6x the 0.00521 sparse-FBP baseline_rmse -> hr=0. FAILURE MODE (now well-characterized): the out-of-domain Mayo prior only ever ADDS RMSE on breast; every lever that reduces its influence improves the metric, which means the recon optimum is the FBP baseline itself and the prior is strictly harmful here. ONE KNOB: init_t 0.4->0.2. HYPOTHESIS: RMSE keeps falling toward (but will not reach) the FBP baseline as init_t->0, confirming prior-domain mismatch as the ceiling; if RMSE ~0.013 persists the prior floor is intrinsic. dc_relax 0.9, eta 1.0, steps 8 held. Budget ~185s.
